title: ASS sidecar export with an explicit font/layout policy
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: ASS sidecar export is admitted only with an explicit AssFontLayoutPolicy that names a requested family, fallbacks, a registered available-family set, and PlayRes/layout values. encode without a policy remains ASS_EXPORT_FONT_POLICY_REQUIRED. A missing requested family is never written as the Style Fontname; the first registered fallback is written, warnings include ASS_FONT_SUBSTITUTED:requested->used and ASS_LAYOUT_MAY_CHANGE, and a Script Info comment records the same fact. No registered substitute is ASS_FONT_UNAVAILABLE. Available names are a DEV registry, not a claim that glyph files were embedded, shaped, or redistributed.

Supported static ASS text, commas, literal braces/backslashes, newlines, emoji, RTL, and exact centisecond (not 30 fps frame) times roundtrip in this subset. Collapsed sub-centisecond ranges are SUBTITLE_TIME_QUANTIZATION. Overrides and unsupported styles continue to warn or drop and are not executed. Import may use the same policy to list a Style-font substitute while still warning ASS_STYLE_FONT_NOT_RENDERED. This slice does not claim lossless arbitrary ASS effects or deterministic shaping.

A workbench path adds an emoji/RTL/newline cue, refuses Export ASS without a policy, then exports with a missing requested font so the sidecar and caption-export-status list the substitute and layout change. An SDK persist path also imports a missing-font ASS with the same policy, confirms SetCaptions(automatic: true) is MANUAL_FIELD_LOCKED on a hand-edited cue, keeps CAPTION_OVERLAP as the determined overlap policy, and keeps MP4 export CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Source-interval crop stays closed.

Already-delivered plain caption domain, split/trim/exact positive-rate map, manual ownership, overlap rejection, bounded SRT/VTT/static ASS import, SRT/VTT export, cue versions/undo/reopen/archive/fork, clipLocal default, explicit source anchors, caption-aware editor commands, and field-aware invert stay unchanged. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP. I-005 and I-010 stay partial.
